scripts.content:validate: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --directory apps/api run python scripts/validate_content.py
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --directory apps/api run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @intenta/web format:check && node scripts/run-uv.mjs --directory apps/api run ruff format --check .
scripts.generate:api: node scripts/run-uv.mjs --directory apps/api run python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @intenta/api-client generate
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @intenta/web lint && node scripts/run-uv.mjs --directory apps/api run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @intenta/web test && node scripts/run-uv.mjs --directory apps/api run pytest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @intenta/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @intenta/web typecheck && node scripts/run-uv.mjs --directory apps/api run mypy app scripts
